column_description: SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each vendor management record.
INT referencing SecurityProfile(SecurityTrace). Ties vendor data with a security profile.
INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Connects vendor data to risk management info.
CHAR(10) an optional cross-ref field, historically 'RecordID'.
VARCHAR(40) describing vendor assessment status. Currently possible values: (Completed, In Progress, Due).
securityrating_enum enumerating vendor security rating. Currently possible values: (A, B, C, D).
DATE indicating when the vendor was last audited.
VARCHAR(30) capturing the contract state. Currently possible values: (Active, Under Review, Expired).
DATE specifying when the current contract expires.
VARCHAR(30) referencing Data Processing Agreement status. Currently possible values: (Required, Signed, Pending).
VARCHAR(30) referencing Standard Contractual Clauses status. Currently possible values: (Implemented, Partial, Not Required).
VARCHAR(30) capturing the status of Binding Corporate Rules. Currently possible values: (Approved, Pending, Not Applicable).
VARCHAR(30) describing the vendor’s documentation completeness. Currently possible values: (Complete, Incomplete, Partial).
VARCHAR(30) enumerating vendor’s policy compliance. Currently possible values: (Partial, Full, Non-compliant).
VARCHAR(30) enumerating vendor’s procedure compliance status. Currently possible values: (Non-compliant, Full, Partial).
VARCHAR(30) referencing the training status of vendor employees. Currently possible values: (Due, Overdue, Current).
VARCHAR(30) referencing certifications the vendor holds. Currently possible values: (Pending, Expired, Valid).
VARCHAR(30) storing the vendor’s monitoring status or approach. Currently possible values: (Inactive, Partial, Active).
VARCHAR(30) capturing the vendor’s reporting requirements or status. Currently possible values: (Delayed, Current, Overdue).
TEXT detailing stakeholder communication or engagement strategy for the vendor relationship. Currently possible values: (Limited, Poor, Regular).
